mapper.insert: insert into vm_flow_link_attr(flow_id, cur_link, link_type, pre_link, next_link, user_type, role_id, org_id, msg_notify_type, leader_flag, sign_flag, rollback_flag, time_limit, attr_flag, alarm_flow_id, notify_admin_flag, msg_notify_limit, msg_notify_company) values (#{flowId}, #{curLink}, #{linkType}, #{preLink}, #{nextLink}, #{userType}, #{roleId}, #{orgId}, #{msgNotifyType}, #{leaderFlag}, #{signFlag}, #{rollbackFlag}, #{timeLimit}, #{attrFlag}, #{alarmFlowId}, #{notifyAdminFlag}, #{msgNotifyLimit}, #{msgNotifyCompany})

insert into vm_flow_link_attr(flow_id, cur_link, link_type, pre_link, next_link, user_type, role_id, org_id, msg_notify_type, leader_flag, sign_flag, rollback_flag, time_limit, attr_flag, alarm_flow_id, notify_admin_flag, msg_notify_limit, msg_notify_company) values
(#{flowLinkAttr.flowId}, #{flowLinkAttr.curLink}, #{flowLinkAttr.linkType}, #{flowLinkAttr.preLink}, #{flowLinkAttr.nextLink}, #{flowLinkAttr.userType}, #{flowLinkAttr.roleId}, #{flowLinkAttr.orgId}, #{flowLinkAttr.msgNotifyType}, #{flowLinkAttr.leaderFlag}, #{flowLinkAttr.signFlag}, #{flowLinkAttr.rollbackFlag}, #{flowLinkAttr.timeLimit}, #{flowLinkAttr.attrFlag}, #{flowLinkAttr.alarmFlowId}, #{flowLinkAttr.notifyAdminFlag}, #{flowLinkAttr.msgNotifyLimit}, #{flowLinkAttr.msgNotifyCompany})
mapper.update:
update vm_flow_link_attr
flow_id = #{flowId},
cur_link = #{curLink},
link_type = #{linkType},
pre_link = #{preLink},
next_link = #{nextLink},
user_type = #{userType},
role_id = #{roleId},
org_id = #{orgId},
msg_notify_type = #{msgNotifyType},
leader_flag = #{leaderFlag},
sign_flag = #{signFlag},
rollback_flag = #{rollbackFlag},
time_limit = #{timeLimit},
attr_flag = #{attrFlag},
notify_admin_flag = #{notifyAdminFlag},
msg_notify_limit = #{msgNotifyLimit},
msg_notify_company = #{msgNotifyCompany},
where flow_link_id = #{flowLinkId}
mapper.select: select em.flow_json,em.flow_name from vm_flow_template em where em.flow_json like CONCAT('%',#{linkId},'%') and em.flow_json like CONCAT('%',(select link_name from vm_flow_link_config where link_id = #{linkId}),'%') and em.status = '1' and em.delete_flag = 0

SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.user_name AS userName, su.dept_id AS deptId, su.user_id AS nodeId, su.user_name AS nodeName FROM sys_user AS su WHERE su.del_flag = '0' and su.dept_id IN
#{deptId}

SELECT ftl.cur_link, flc.link_name, ftl.pre_link, ftl.next_link FROM vm_flow_template_link as ftl INNER JOIN vm_flow_link_attr as fla on fla.link_id = ftl.cur_link and fla.template_id = ftl.template_id LEFT JOIN ${warnTableName} wo on fla.alarm_flow_id = wo.flow_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_config flc on ftl.cur_link = flc.link_id WHERE wo.warning_order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT ftl.cur_link, flc.link_name, ftl.pre_link, ftl.next_link FROM vm_flow_template_link as ftl INNER JOIN ${warnTableName} wo on ftl.template_id = wo.flow_template LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_config flc on ftl.cur_link = flc.link_id WHERE wo.warning_order_id = #{orderId}

select distinct su.user_id as userId, su.NICK_NAME as userName, su.dept_id as deptId, su.user_id as nodeId, su.user_name as nodeName, su.user_name as nickName, su.AVATAR as avatar, '0' as tenantAdmin, '0' as purviewFlag from sys_user as su
left join sys_user_role as sur on su.user_id = sur.user_id
where su.DEL_FLAG='0' and su.STATUS='0' and
FIND_IN_SET( #{deptId} ,su.dept_id)
and su.tenant_id = #{model.tenantId}
and (
su.user_id IN
#{userId}
or
sur.role_id IN
#{roleId}
)
and su.NICK_NAME like concat('%', #{model.userName}, '%')
group by su.user_id

select su.user_id as userId, su.NICK_NAME as userName, su.dept_id as deptId, su.user_id as nodeId, su.user_name as nodeName, su.user_name as nickName, su.AVATAR as avatar, su.is_tenant_admin as tenantAdmin, '1' as purviewFlag from sys_user as su where su.DEL_FLAG='0' and su.STATUS='0' and su.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and su.is_tenant_admin ='1' limit 1
